result.topic_en: Geodetic height (levelling) computations from Gauss's 1824 survey in the Hanover/Bremen region: reductions of observed zenith distances between triangulation stations, the resulting least-squares conditions for the station heights a–m, the sum of squared residuals with the derived mean error, and a list of heights at Zeven and other places.

Normal equations of the least-squares adjustment for the height corrections
Mean error from sum of squared residuals divided by (number of observations minus number of unknowns), then square root
